Steward.read: Core party-scaling target if the player is quartermaster.

Two Handed.read: Default stop is 175; later focus is optional.

Riding.read: Only needs one focus for Riding 100 in infantry doctrine.

Bow.read: Ranged-side plan only; Bow 100 Merry Men costs two focus under assisted Control 4 and is too thin for default infantry.

Leadership.read: Useful party-size stretch; Social still stays at 2.

Tactics.read: Soft leak unless Tactics 200 is planned.

Engineering.read: Convertible hard leak: delegate by default, but Engineering 225 Metallurgy can justify a late player-engineer stretch.
